subject: inorganic
question:
无机化学·配位化学：请判断下列配合物的几何构型：Pentamethyltantalum（TaMe₅）？
A. Square pyramidal
B. Trigonal bipyramidal
C. Octahedral
D. Linear
explanation: Square pyramidal. Covalent count: Ta (group 5) 5 e; 5 × Me (X) 5 e: 10 e. Ionic count: the ligands carry a charge of −5 in all and the complex is neutral, so the metal is Ta(V), d⁰; d⁰ + 10 e from the ligands = 10 e. Square pyramidal, not trigonal bipyramidal: d⁰ ML₅ with only σ-donors often prefers the pyramid.
